title: Preserve authored track short names
scope: Retain GPIF ShortName independently from the full track name through parsing and GP8 export.
acceptance: Use different full and short names on two tracks and verify exact identities through the public API.
Cover empty, Unicode and XML-sensitive short names without automatic truncation.
The pinned consumer sees the exact short name after a public edit and export.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at tracks[0].shortName. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.
